description: This file defines a 'ProductGrid' component using LightningJS, which renders a grid of product cards based on provided product data. It includes properties, computed values, and methods for layout calculations and accessing product data.

classes.name: ProductGrid
classes.description: A LightningJS component class that renders a grid layout of product cards based on given product data.

methods.name: $index
methods.description: Calculates a linear index based on row and column indices.

methods.name: $productByRowCol
methods.description: Retrieves the product at the specified row and column.

methods.name: $rowY
methods.description: Calculates the Y position for a given row index.

methods.name: $colX
methods.description: Calculates the X position for a given column index.
